title: Gator Painting Company vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Ocala business owners comparing Gator Painting Company and Precision Paint Experts: how to plan commercial painting around customers and operating hours.
h1: Gator Painting Company vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: For Ocala shops, restaurants, and offices, the best paint job is one your customers barely notice happening. Here is how to compare commercial bids.

questions: Can commercial painting be done at night or on weekends?
What should a business ask before hiring a commercial painter?

sections.h2: Keeping an Ocala business open while it gets painted
body: Gator Painting Company is one of the painting and property-service companies Ocala business owners may be comparing. For a storefront, restaurant, or office, the cost of a paint project is not only the invoice. It is also any lost sales, closed dining rooms, or staff working around ladders. The way a contractor plans around your hours can matter as much as the coatings it specifies.
This guide offers questions to ask any commercial painter and explains how Precision Paint Experts schedules and documents commercial work in Ocala and across Marion County.

Owners and managers usually have a property manager, landlord, or corporate office to answer to as well, so the documents behind the bid carry weight. A proposal that is clear about hours, insurance, and scope is easier to approve and easier to hold a contractor to.

Commercial work at Precision Paint Experts is scheduled around operating hours, including nights and weekends. A restaurant can be painted after close and be ready for the next lunch service; a retail floor can be done in sections so aisles stay open; an office can be painted over a weekend so Monday starts normally. Our retail and restaurant painting and office painting pages describe how that works in each setting.

sections.h2: Questions to ask a commercial bidder
body: Ask each contractor to put these answers in the proposal:
bullets: Can the work be done outside business hours, and is that reflected in the schedule?
How will floors, fixtures, and inventory be protected?
Can you provide a certificate of insurance naming our business before work starts?
Will your own employees be on site, or subcontractors?
Which products are specified for high-traffic walls and doors?

sections.h2: What we put in a commercial proposal
body: We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member, and a certificate of insurance naming your entity is available before mobilization. We use our own crews and do not subcontract. Our proposal lists surfaces included and excluded, prep, primer and topcoat products by name, coat counts, and the schedule. For doors and railings that take constant contact, we use waterborne urethane enamel. Low-VOC options are available for spaces that reopen quickly.
For larger buildings, see our commercial interior painting and commercial exterior painting services.

A crew lead walks the space, measures, and photographs conditions, usually within 48 hours of your request. The itemized proposal usually follows within one business day. Compare it against other Ocala bids with the questions above, and pay particular attention to how each one handles your hours.

It also helps to share your busiest days and any events on the calendar during the walkthrough. A schedule built around that information from the start avoids last-minute changes. Once the work is done, a final walkthrough catches anything that is not right before the job is closed out, and you sign the punch walk.

faqs.q: Can you paint our restaurant after closing time?
faqs.a: Yes. Commercial work is scheduled around operating hours, including nights and weekends.

faqs.q: Will you provide a COI naming our business?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming your entity is available before mobilization.

faqs.q: Do you serve businesses outside Ocala?
faqs.a: Yes. We serve Marion County including Ocala, Dunnellon, and Belleview, plus Alachua, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist counties.
